text_blocks.snippet: In the United States, the prevalence of diagnosed and undiagnosed diabetes is 15.8% among adults, with 11.3% having diagnosed diabetes and 4.5% with undiagnosed diabetes. This translates to approximately 38.4 million adults living with diabetes, with 8.7 million unaware of their condition. The prevalence of diabetes varies across demographics, increasing with age and weight status, and decreasing with higher educational attainment.
